purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and schema-first anonymous public geometry review.
assessment: Cameroon’s MINDCAF administers land, cadastre and land-affairs services. Its public organization/procedure materials define regional and departmental cadastral responsibilities; the Cameroon government eRegulations procedure directory specifically lists the Délégation départementale des domaines, du cadastre et des affaires foncières at Centre administratif, Garoua and the Bénoué departmental cadastre bureau. The public listing confirms a local registry/cadastre custodian, but no public parcel geometry service or schema was identified. MINDCAF official material defines departmental cadastral duties; the public Garoua procedure directory lists the Bénoué departmental cadastre bureau and MINDCAF delegation in Garoua. The ministry’s official page also documents title issuance involving Garoua. No city-specific public parcel viewer, vector schema or anonymous feature endpoint was found.
